fnol_text: My name is Owen Whitfield and I live at 414 Larkspur Avenue, Madison, WI 53739. You can reach me on (555) 603-2381 or owen.whitfield@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 27 April 2026, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2025-00091. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Whitfield on (555) 603-2381 to acknowledge the claim. Owen confirmed the loss date as 27 April 2026.
Site visit to 414 Larkspur Avenue. Neighbour Owen Herrera was present and confirmed the timeline.
Owen sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
